# 3 bedroom detached house for sale

> A detached 3 bedroom dwelling with planning permission to extend, existing business (Belmont Unleashed - dog exercise fields) with 5.97 acres approximately. The property offers prospective purchasers numerous business and development options (subject to any necessary consents). Belmont Farm consists of a detached 3-bedroom dwelling with planning permission to extend the property.
